reviews.comment: I enjoyed taking Dr. McGuire's section. Tax is a difficult/boring topic, but his lectures were engaging, and you can tell he loves the subject as well as cares about his students' success. I liked how in lecture, he does not expect students to somehow write every word he says down if he says it once. He will repeat the key takeaways over and over

He is an amazing professor who truly wants his students to do well. Tax is a hard class with pretty boring subject matter, but he does a great job of making it interesting with jokes and stories. Best professor I have ever had, and an all around great person. Take his class!

Sean is the best professor at Mays. He actually makes income tax an enjoyable course with his stories, examples, and engaging lecture style. He is also an awesome person who will help his students in any way he can. He is literally the best professor I have ever taken! I highly recommend taking him. His class is challenging but fair.
